hero.title: REIMAGINE SOCIAL
hero.tagline: The social medium designed to set you free, not keep you hooked.

finiteEpochs.heading: Finite Epochs
finiteEpochs.body: A bounded daily stream with a definitive horizon. Once you finish today’s reflections, you are caught up and free.

resonance.heading: Qualitative Resonance
resonance.body: Four dimensions of human connection: Perspective Shift, Grounding Calm, Creative Spark, and Shared Humanity.

campfire.heading: The Campfire
campfire.body: Gather in real-time around ambient procedural soundscapes and ephemeral thought ripples without surveillance.

constellation.heading: Constellations
constellation.body: Discover kindred minds connected through intellectual and creative frequencies rather than follower counts.

slowLetters.heading: Slow Letters
slowLetters.body: Deliberate letters sealed with wax and delivered at golden hour (Dawn or Dusk) to restore genuine correspondence.

bridge.heading: The pause before you scroll.
bridge.body: Every infinite feed relies on you scrolling before you think. REIMAGINE SOCIAL puts one intentional moment of presence between dopamine casino loops and your real life.

bridge.stat2dd: No outrage optimization, no follower counts, no vanity scorecards

bazaar.heading: Connect like gathering around a hearth.
bazaar.body: Experience daily finite epochs, ambient synchronous campfires, and unhurried slow letters. Step into a social space that respects your human dignity.
